$comment: GitHub and the board: work an issue as a task; the room hears when the pull request it names opens and merges; merged, the task is done and the issue closes.
do: caption:Work an issue as a task|The issue stays in GitHub. The work happens here.
click:Hand something off to the room…
fill:Hand something off to the room…=Fix tax rounding on receipts github.com/coffee-shop/web/issues/118 @coder

eval:(() => { const c = document.querySelector('[data-testid="thread-conversation"]'); if (!c) return; let n = c; while (n && !/(auto|scroll)/.test(getComputedStyle(n).overflowY)) n = n.parentElement; if (!n) return; const go = () => n.scrollTo({ top: n.scrollHeight, behavior: 'smooth' }); go(); new MutationObserver(go).observe(c, { childList: true, subtree: true }); })()
caption:The coder names its pull request in the task|and the room follows it from there.
caption:The room hears what matters|when it opens, if CI goes red, and when it merges.
caption:Merged, the task is done, and the issue closes in GitHub
